description: A long rectangular gauntlet. Arjuna starts at the west end (x=0). Jayadratha hides behind layers of Kaurava defenders at the far east end. A sunset timer ends the mission.

tile_overrides.note: First defensive embankmment — Drona's vanguard holds here.
Fortified wall of ELEPHANT_CORPS protecting Jayadratha.
Jayadratha's final position. gate-blocker trait prevents all Pandavas except Arjuna from targeting him.

PANDAVA.note: Arjuna spawns at (0, 5) with Krishna as charioteer.

timer.fail_condition: If Jayadratha is not defeated by end of turn 20, Arjuna self-immolates (instant game-over, fail_on_deviation: true).
timer.note: Krishna's eclipse ruse happens mid-battle — a VNScene pause at a specific narrative turn that briefly fools Jayadratha into thinking he's survived.

special_mechanics.gate_blocker: Jayadratha's gate-blocker trait makes him untargetable by all Pandavas except Arjuna. Only Arjuna's attacks register damage on Jayadratha tile.
special_mechanics.eclipse_ruse: At turn 15, trigger seq-krishna-eclipse: Krishna temporarily obscures the sun. Jayadratha lowers guard (loses 1 turn), but VN reveal occurs before Arjuna can exploit it — Arjuna must still close distance.
